goals.title: 이 프로젝트에서 사용하는 api avb 실행해서 테스트해보기. 로컬 Android 프로젝트 bankramen-android에...
goals.objective: 이 프로젝트에서 사용하는 api avb 실행해서 테스트해보기. 로컬 Android 프로젝트 bankramen-android에서 실제로 존재하는 API/OpenAPI/AVD 관련 실행 표면을 확인하고, 실행 가능한 가장 좁은 검증 명령을 돌려 결과를 증거로 남긴다. 코드 변경은 하지 않는다.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI auxiliary surface: run ./gradlew :app:generateBankramenApi | tee .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C001-generateBankramenApi.log; PASS if command exits 0, log contains BUILD SUCCESSFUL, and app/build/generated/openapi/src/main/kotlin/com/uson/myapplication/generated/api contains generated API files.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: CLI stdout: .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C001-generateBankramenApi.log contains BUILD SUCCESSFUL; generated files: .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C001-generated-files.txt lists APIApi.kt, CategoryApi.kt, MonthlyReportApi.kt, PushNotificationApi.kt, TransactionApi.kt | cleanup: no persistent process spawned; build output only under Gradle build directory

successCriteria.scenario: CLI auxiliary surface: run ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests com.uson.myapplication.core.api.BankramenApiCoverageTest | tee .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C002-api-coverage-test.log; PASS if command exits 0 and executes BankramenApiCoverageTest successfully.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: CLI stdout: .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C002-api-coverage-test.log contains BUILD SUCCESSFUL; copied JUnit XML .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C002-BankramenApiCoverageTest.xml reports tests=4 skipped=0 failures=0 errors=0 | cleanup: no persistent process spawned; Gradle daemon left as standard project build service

successCriteria.scenario: Android AVD surface: run android emulator list, android emulator start Pixel_10_Pro, ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug, android run --apks app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk, then android layout -p. PASS if the emulator boots, the APK launches, and the layout dump/screenshot is captured; BLOCKED if emulator tooling cannot start a device in this environment.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C003-avd-run.log, C003-layout.json, and optional C003-screen.png with cleanup receipt stopping emulator if started.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Android AVD surface: .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C003-avd-run.log shows Pixel_10_Pro booted as emulator-5554, :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL, app loaded com.uson.myapplication, install completed, activation completed; layout .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C003-layout.json contains login screen text; screenshot .omo/ulw-loop/api-avb-20260708/evidence/C003-screen.png inspected | cleanup: android emulator stop Pixel_10_Pro attempted and adb devices after cleanup shows no attached devices
